fundamentalRule: Customer Requirement is demand; OEM vendor quotation is evidence. Only engineering validation can connect these, with retained conditions, explicit quantity and ONE cost owner.

equations.name: Source identity
equations.expression: K=(ProjectID, MR, Site, TAG, sourceRow, sourceRevision)
equations.purpose: Find exactly one RFQ/MTO origin; no fallback to similar site or tag

equations.name: Requirement thread
equations.purpose: Merge traceable particular requirements and identify applicable function/technical proof; retain revisions

equations.name: Required function decomposition
equations.expression: F_required(K)=Decompose(R(K), topology, interface, system architecture, existing system)
equations.purpose: A TAG Set is not one vendor SKU; mandatory functions may map to adjacent TAG cost owners

equations.name: Candidate join
equations.expression: Candidate(f,o)=1 only if SourceLineID, quote ID, SKU and function are cross-referenced by evidence; quote rate/unit/currency match source
equations.purpose: Find vendor candidates from 07 Vendor (not raw keyword-only or vendor price-only)

equations.name: Technical hard-constraint gate
equations.expression: Eligible(f,o)=AND(Verified(c_i,f,o) for every mandatory hard constraint c_i), or approved deviation with documented disposition
equations.purpose: Missing Ex/country/licence/throughput proof is UNKNOWN or CONFLICT, never silently compliant

equations.name: Engineering quantity driver
equations.expression: Q_required(f,K)=N_verified_endpoints(K) × q_per_endpoint(f) + documented spare/other explicit drivers
equations.purpose: One Set does not mean every physical SKU quantity 1 without an explicit driver; offered quoted quantity is evidence only

equations.name: Unique cost ownership
equations.expression: For a scope/function instance i: SUM_{owner} allocationShare(i,owner)=1 and owner is stable site+TAG+row; counted once
equations.purpose: B-6/B-7 at IDU row5, B-8 at surge row10, B-12 at antenna row6, no duplication in ODU row4

equations.name: Sourced monetary calculation
equations.expression: Extended(f,c)=Q_required(f) × SourceUnitRate(f,c); SUM by currency and owner only; rate NULL -> UNKNOWN, not zero
equations.purpose: Allow a separate explicitly labelled managerial incremental assumption but retain source NULL unchanged

equations.name: Ledger reconciliation
equations.expression: Delta(owner,c)=MappedTotal(owner,c) − FrozenWorkingLedger(owner,c); PASS if currency identical and |Delta|<=0.01
equations.purpose: Never mutate the existing Cost Ledger from an audit. Any mismatch blocks mapping promotion until corrected.

equations.name: Commercial continuation and release
equations.expression: BudgetaryProceed=SourceMatch && QuantityTrace && CostReconciled; TechnicalRelease=AllHardConstraintsProvenOrApproved; these are independent
equations.purpose: Work on qualified budgetary basis while retaining deviation and evidence requirements; no automatic technical approval

classifications.ERROR: Document/quote/quantity/owner/currency/reconciliation invariant failed. Stop this mapping and do not book cost.
classifications.QUALIFIED: Budgetary scenario can proceed on controlled assumption; missing technical/approval/price proof remains visible; not a technical PASS.
classifications.PASS: A documented mapping/invariant has matched exactly, not an OEM/Company approval.
classifications.NOT_APPLICABLE: Verified inapplicable function, never inferred from lack of data.

scopeExpansion: Pilot ZWP20 MR-502-001 row4. Rollout to other TAGs requires their own source identity/topology/quantity evidence and same equation tests.
